Starting with savings products, please detail the eligibility criteria for different types including regular savings, salary-linked savings, senior citizen savings, and basic savings bank deposit products. For each type, provide the list of required documents such as identity proof, address proof, PAN card, photographs, and any additional documents for specific categories like minor holders, joint holders, or HUF holders. Please describe the verification process including video verification options, the typical activation timeline, and the initial deposit requirements. Moving to transaction services, I need details about the various channels available including branch banking, ATM banking, internet banking, mobile banking, phone banking, and SMS banking. For each channel, describe the daily transaction limits for fund transfers including NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, and UPI, the bill payment facilities available, and any channel-specific features or restrictions. I am particularly interested in understanding the security features implemented across channels such as two-factor authentication, transaction PIN, biometric authentication, and device binding. Please also describe the process for increasing transaction limits and the approval mechanism involved. Regarding maintenance, provide details about the minimum average balance requirements for different variants, the penalties levied for non-maintenance of minimum balance, the statement generation frequency and delivery options, and the process for requesting statements for specific periods. I would also like to understand the cheque book issuance process, the types of cheque books available, and the pricing associated with cheque book issuance and cheque return. Additionally, describe the demand draft and pay order issuance process, the applicable pricing, and the validity period. For card-related services, please describe the debit card variants available, their annual fees, the ATM withdrawal and POS transaction limits, the international usage enablement process, and the card replacement procedure in case of loss or damage. Include details about virtual debit cards and their usage for online transactions. Coming to nomination and modification services, describe the process for adding or changing nomination, updating contact details, changing the operating mode, converting a single holding to joint or vice versa, and linking or delinking for sweep facility. I also need to understand the process for dormant or inactive reactivation, the conditions under which products become dormant, and any pricing associated with reactivation. For closure, detail the process including the notice period if any, the settlement of pending transactions, the final balance disbursement options, and any closure pricing applicable for premature closure of specific product types. Please also cover the deceased holder settlement process including the documentation required from legal heirs or nominees, the timeline for settlement, and any special provisions for jointly held products. Furthermore, describe your portability services if any, the process for transferring between branches, and whether reference numbers change during such transfers. I am also interested in understanding the regulatory compliance requirements such as periodic verification updates, FATCA and CRS declarations for NRI products, and TDS applicability on interest earned. This extremely detailed overview will help me understand the full lifecycle of product management at your bank and make an informed decision about utilizing your services.
